claims.claim: BTS won Artist of the Year at the 2026 American Music Awards on May 25 in Las Vegas.
The Artist of the Year field included Taylor Swift, Bad Bunny, Bruno Mars, Harry Styles, Lady Gaga, Kendrick Lamar, Justin Bieber, Morgan Wallen and Sabrina Carpenter.
sources: Forbes Artist of the Year report

claims.claim: BTS also won Song of the Summer for SWIM.
The AMAs broadcast opened with a pre-recorded Hooligan performance from the Las Vegas ARIRANG tour stop.
E! described the 2026 AMAs as BTS's first award-show performance in four years, with the performance shown as pre-taped footage.
BTS's 2021 Artist of the Year win was the first time an Asian act won the fan-voted AMAs grand prize.
BTS returned after military service with ARIRANG and an accompanying world tour.
BTS made its U.S. TV performance debut at the 2017 AMAs with DNA.
